# PT Mustika Buana Sejahtera (MBS)

> CARB Phase II and JAS-certified plywood and blockboard manufacturer based in Lumajang, East Java, Indonesia. Exporting to buyers across Asia, the Americas, Europe, Africa and Oceania since 2006. Part of Mustikatama Group, founded 1989.

## Company

- **Full name:** PT Mustika Buana Sejahtera
- **Short name:** MBS
- **Type:** Manufacturer and exporter of timber panel products
- **Established:** 2006
- **Location:** Jl. Raya Lumajang–Tempeh KM 7, Lumajang 67371, East Java, Indonesia
- **Parent group:** Mustikatama Group (est. 1989)
- **Workers:** 1,500+
- **Port of export:** Tanjung Perak, Surabaya, East Java (FOB, C&F, CIF available)

## Products

### Plywood
- Multi-layer cross-laminated panels made from Albizia Falcata (Sengon) veneer
- Thickness: 3mm – 25mm
- Standard size: 1220 × 2440 mm (custom sizes available)
- Grade: BB/BB (JAS standard)
- Glue: E0 / CARB P2 (low formaldehyde emission)
- Applications: furniture, construction, industrial panels

### Blockboard
- Solid Sengon strip core bonded between veneer faces
- Thickness: 12mm – 30mm
- Standard size: 1220 × 2440 mm
- Applications: furniture panels, cabinet doors, shelving, interior finishing
- Low weight, dimensionally stable

## Certifications

- **CARB Phase II (ATCM)** — Certificate No. TPC6/CARB-ATCM/M019-HWPW014. Qualifies for sale in California and satisfies US federal TSCA Title VI requirements.
- **JAS (Japan Agricultural Standards)** — mandatory certification for plywood sold in Japan's commercial and residential market.
- **V-Legal / SVLK** — Indonesian timber legality verification confirming plantation origin and legal chain of custody. Required for EU-market exports.

## Export Markets

- **Japan** — JAS certified, primary market
- **USA** — CARB II compliant
- **Europe** — V-Legal / SVLK certified
- **China & Asia** — primary regional market
- **Oceania** — Australia and New Zealand
- **Africa** — growing market

## Commercial Terms

- **MOQ:** 1 × 40ft High Cube container (~60 CBM)
- **Lead time:** 4–6 weeks from order confirmation
- **Payment:** 30% deposit on confirmation, 70% before shipment
- **Incoterms:** FOB Surabaya, C&F, CIF
- **Samples:** 150×300mm cut pieces available (buyer pays courier)

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: What is the MOQ for plywood or blockboard?**
A: 1 × 40ft High Cube container, approximately 60 CBM. Mixed product orders (plywood + blockboard) can be discussed.

**Q: Does MBS hold CARB certification?**
A: Yes. CARB Phase II (ATCM) certificate number TPC6/CARB-ATCM/M019-HWPW014. Valid for hardwood plywood panels sold in California and meets US TSCA Title VI requirements.

**Q: Is JAS-certified plywood available?**
A: Yes. MBS holds JAS certification for plywood panels. BB/BB grade, E0 glue, suitable for Japan market.

**Q: What species is used?**
A: Albizia Falcata (Sengon / Paraserianthes falcataria) — a fast-growing plantation species from East Java, Indonesia.

**Q: Where does MBS ship from?**
A: Tanjung Perak Port, Surabaya, East Java — approximately 2.5 hours from the factory.

**Q: What is the lead time?**
A: 4–6 weeks from order confirmation and deposit receipt.
